AC verification correction (link direction). The last acceptance criterion says the discovered gaps are 'checked by `rebar show 7e0d-7815-4425-4fdb` listing one link per such marker'. rebar stores a `discovered_from` edge on the CHILD, which is the correct direction (child discovered_from parent), so the links surface on the two child tickets rather than on this one. Evidence, both confirmed:

  rebar show cushy-soldierly-sunbear    -> deps [('discovered_from', '7e0d-7815-4425-4fdb')]
  rebar show marauding-hornblende-bluet -> deps [('discovered_from', '7e0d-7815-4425-4fdb')]

That is one link per gap-citing marker: e818-564e-d3b6-4eaa for the two `test.yml` golden-path markers (one ticket covers both steps, which cite it jointly), and d93e-92ce-e2d0-4033 for the `_optionality.yml` degradation-path marker. The criterion's intent — every marker that claims a gap names a real, linked ticket — is met; only the side the command inspects was named wrongly, and the description is not being edited to fix it because that would invalidate the certified plan-review attestation.
